subject: Qwen3.6-27B GDN Dk128->64 speed oracle on Ascend 910B4
rationale: The source and Dk64 checkpoints both loaded real weights and the treatment exercised head_k_dim=64.
On the exact 361-input/32-output ignore_eos warm7 workload, median TPOT was 369.1616 ms/token for baseline and 369.1632 ms/token for Dk64: no measurable decode gain.
Because the performance gate failed before quality qualification, DRRQR construction and native profiling are not justified for this Qwen3.6 target. No accuracy-lossless claim is made.
required_for_adopt: a materially different implementation or workload hypothesis that first clears the warm performance gate
G1-G4 orthogonal ablation with three repetitions and mean/std
hash-bound profile correlation for G1 versus the unique winning group on both models, with capture disabled and matching frozen/config/treatment bindings
accuracy_wording_rule: Only say accuracy lossless within measured NPU noise on this frozen suite after aggregate, per-dataset/category, deterministic canary, and variance gates pass. A generic 1-2pp threshold alone is insufficient for structural pruning.
